item.title: Newscast – Monday, June 1, 2026
item.description: In this newscast: Southeast Alaska Regional Health Consortium opened a new urgent care facility in downtown Juneau over the weekend; King salmon sport fishing opened today in Juneau’s hatchery harvest areas; Monday was the last day to officially begin a campaign for state or federal office in Alaska, after a few shakeups late last week. As Alaska Public Media’s Eric Stone reports, there were also some twists in the hours before today’s deadline; Petersburg’s local tribe launched its first canoe in a century last Sunday setting out on a canoe Journey to the biennial Celebration Festival in Juneau. Pullers from around the region joined the highly-anticipated launch out of Petersburg, and dozens of people gathered dockside to see them off on the multi-day Journey.

item.description: He was caught pulling the corners of his eyes at a South Korean influencer during the match in Mexico.

item.title: Oil prices slide after US-Iran deal announced
item.description: Under the agreement, the key Strait of Hormuz waterway will be reopened, US President Donald Trump said.

item.title: Hurricanes legend turned coach Rod Brind'Amour makes history as team wins Stanley Cup over Golden Knights
item.description: The Carolina Hurricanes won the Stanley Cup for the first time in two decades, defeating the Vegas Golden Knights in Game 6 with goals from Taylor Hall and Jackson Blake.

item.title: Arrest made after seizure of Russian oil tanker in Channel
item.description: National Crime Agency officers detain an Indian national on suspicion of sanctions offences.

item.title: Trump heralds Iran deal but questions - and risks - remain
item.description: The announcement of an Iran deal was a welcome birthday gift for the president – but its success or failure may hinge on the details.

item.title: Multi-day severe storm outbreak to slam Midwest and Northeast, following days of tornadoes and damaging winds
item.description: A multi-day severe storm outbreak is set to slam portions of the Midwest and Northeast by midweek. This comes just days after tornadoes, destructive winds and large hail moved through many of the same areas. Severe weather will begin Tuesday in Illinois and Indiana, sparking thunderstorms with gusty winds and hail.

item.title: National Guardsman pleads guilty to fatal shooting of soldier he found in bed with his ex-girlfriend
item.description: A U.S. Army National Guardsman pleaded guilty to killing a soldier he found in bed with his ex-girlfriend at Fort Gordon in Augusta, Georgia.

item.title: Trump hosts UFC cage fight on the White House lawn
item.description: Thousands were expected to attend the mixed martial arts fight, which coincides with Trump's 80th birthday.

item.title: Tom Brady and Bridget Moynahan reunite at son Jack's high school graduation
item.description: Tom Brady and ex-girlfriend Bridget Moynahan reunited to celebrate son Jack's high school graduation, sharing heartfelt tribute posts on Instagram.

item.title: US-Iran deal eases uncertainty over the war - but there is much still to play out
item.description: Pakistan says the deal includes Lebanon, but recent ceasefires there have failed to take hold.

item.title: Crude oil futures drop after Trump promises an Iran deal will be signed Friday
item.description: Oil prices had already fallen quite dramatically on Thursday and Friday, in anticipation of an imminent deal. President Trump has posted online that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen after the deal is signed on Friday.

item.title: Trump announces peace deal with Iran, declares Strait of Hormuz will reopen: 'Let the oil flow!'
item.description: President Trump announces U.S.-Iran peace deal, authorizing the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and removal of the naval blockade with a signing set for Friday.

item.title: Mamdani parties with Knicks champion Jose Alvarado on Puerto Rican Day Parade float in New York
item.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani and New York Knicks guard Jose Alvarado celebrated at the Puerto Rican Day Parade after New York's first NBA title since 1973.

item.title: Scottish fan has priceless reaction after seeing New England Patriots cheerleaders at World Cup game
item.description: A Scottish fan at the 2026 FIFA World Cup in Boston was hilariously mesmerized by New England Patriots cheerleaders during Scotland vs. Haiti.

item.title: Andy Reid addresses whether upcoming Taylor Swift-Travis Kelce wedding is a distraction: 'Can't talk about it'
item.description: Chiefs coach Andy Reid says Travis Kelce is focused on football despite upcoming wedding to Taylor Swift, noting he's been present all offseason.

item.title: 2-2 draw for Japan and the Netherlands in World Cup opener for both
item.description: Daichi Kamada scored on a header off Koki Ogawa's corner kick in the 88th minute, sending the Samurai Blue fans into a frenzy and giving Japan a 2-2 draw with the Netherlands in their World Cup opener.

item.title: Havertz sparks Germany's 7-1 rout of Curaçao after underdogs' historic 1st goal in World Cup
item.description: Kai Havertz scored two goals as Germany pulled away from World Cup first-timer Curaçao late in the opening half and piled on after that in a 7-1 win in a group match.

item.title: Spencer Pratt unites with Karen Bass' brother to sue the LA mayor over Palisades fire destruction
item.description: Spencer Pratt says he is teaming up with Karen Bass' brother Kenneth Bass in suing the LA mayor over alleged negligence in the Palisades fire.

item.title: Fate of historic slavery exhibit targeted by Trump hangs in the balance
item.description: A federal judge has temporarily blocked President Trump's order to remove some exhibits at national parks. One historic site targeted by that order faces an uncertain future.

item.title: Assisted dying returns to Parliament as MP urges peers to 'finish the job'
item.description: Lauren Edwards says she will bring the exact same bill which was narrowly passed by the Commons but ran out of time in the Lords.

item.title: Roy Hattersley, former Labour deputy leader, dies aged 93
item.description: Paying tribute, Sir Keir Starmer said Lord Hattersley "was a giant of the Labour movement".

item.title: Former Republican Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell hospitalized
item.description: A spokesman for former Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell said the Kentucky republican was admitted to a hospital on Sunday.
